182887.overview: An arkanoid-styled game. Fast, smooth and staggeringly difficult, with lots of power-ups and other features. 150 levels plus bonus screens.

182888.overview: Boing's time machine has crashed on a strange land and only by collecting 20 Potions, the Crystal, the Battery and the all-important lever will he ever get the time machine working again

459531.overview:
Homebrew port of the classic Atari 3D vector shooting game, BattleZone.

The aim of the game is to trundle around the world hunting the enemy.  The enemy is also hunting you!  There is only ever one hostile enemy in the world at any given time.  Sometimes a benign Flying Saucer will float around the world too - it offers no physical threat other than distraction.  Big points if you destroy it!

Your Battle Tank is equipped with a single-shot cannon.  Once fired you cannot fire again until your shell hits something or reaches the end of its life - which is just over 2 seconds after firing.  During the shell's flight your gunsight will flash to signal that firing again is not possible.  When the flashing stops your weapon is active again.


TWIN TRACK CONTROLS:

You are driving a tank, so the default controls mimic the coin-op.  This means you control the left and right tracks independently.  It takes a little getting used to, but once mastered it becomes quite intuitive.

This 'Twin Track' control style is the game's default.

TRADITIONAL CONTROL STYLE (Twin Track) KEYS:

LEFT TRACK:
  FORWARD ........... A
  REVERSE ........... Z

RIGHT TRACK:
  FORWARD ........... L
  REVERSE ........... , (comma)

FIRE WEAPON ......... SPACE

TOGGLE ENGINE SOUND . F0


There is an alternative control style available which uses forward, reverse, rotate left and rotate right.

ALTERNATIVE CONTROL STYLE (Rotational) KEYS:

DIRECTION:
  FORWARD ........... Q
  REVERSE ........... A

ROTATION:
  LEFT .............. O
  RIGHT ............. P

FIRE WEAPON ......... SPACE

TOGGLE ENGINE SOUND . F0
Use the TOGGLE ENGINE SOUND key to silence the (very) annoying 'engine' sound of your own tank...  You will want to do this!


Only one control style is active during the game.  To change the control style, and/or redefine the control keys, press 'K' anywhere during the rolling attract sequences.  Once you have changed control style and/or keys they remain in force for your current gaming session, or until changed again.  Control choices will also persist across game re-loads for those with a Quazar TRINITY interface.  See below.

Pressing 'SPACE' (the START GAME key) anywhere during the rolling attract sequences will start a new game.

459538.overview:
Port of the Game Boy version of Bubble Ghost (originally an Atari ST title) complete with authentic monochrome graphics!

Take a deep breath and enter a topsy-turvy world where one of your greatest enemies is... an electric fan? Control the cute Ghost who loves blowing a bubble through a wacky haunted house. His soft breath can move it, but a fragile bubble doesnt stand a ghost of a chance against a candle flame or the breeze from a fan. If the bubble bursts-pop goes the puzzle! Maneuvering around the many hazards is only part of the fun, you must also find your way through the maze-like halls. Its an a-mazing puzzle that will blow your mind and leave you breathless!

- Adapted from the international best-selling PC game

- 35 screens-each one trickier than the last

- Bonus bar gives you the extra points for speed

- Challenges your speed, reflexes, timing and your mind!

Sam Conversion extra features:

- Extra challenge levels

- Selectable palette

459651.overview:
Pac-Man style game with 100 different mazes and the main player sprite changed to a ladybird. In later levels there are also phantom walls, and doors that need keys to be collected before you can pass through them.

Unlike Pac-Man, the ghosts in this game do not hunt you down, instead they move around randomly.

The game was originally pitched as “Mr Pac”, with a yellow circular main character sprite, and music inspired by Pacmania and the Pac-Man arcade game.

Game codes:

ZIP	Infinite lives
FOX	Start Level 11
LIE	Start Level 21
ALE	Start Level 31
RAT	Start Level 41
TNT	Start Level 51
KEY	Start Level 61
WEB	Start Level 71
GIN	Start Level 81
OFF	Start Level 91

459754.overview:
Bowin and the Count Dracula is a classic platformer game released in 1991 for the SAM Coupé. Developed by João Silva and David Serafim, the game takes players on an adventurous journey through the 'Valley of Death'. Players guide Bowin, the protagonist, as he navigates various levels filled with obstacles and enemies, including bats and ghosts.

The game is set against a backdrop of eerie landscapes and moonlit skies, enhancing the mysterious atmosphere. Players must collect gems and avoid dangers to progress through the levels. The pixel art style and challenging gameplay make it a notable title for platformer enthusiasts.

This game was originally lined-up to be released by Revelation. An enhanced version, featuring Quazar Surround sound, was later released by Persona.

459808.overview:
Booty is a classic 8-bit platform game set on a pirate ship. The player takes on the role of a cabin boy who attempts to steal a hoard of treasure from his pirate masters. A variety of hazards must be avoided including pirates, parrots and booby-trapped treasure

The gameplay involves solving puzzles and finding keys to unlock doors, adding a layer of strategy to the platforming action.

It's a conversion of the well-received ZX Spectrum game released by Firebird Software in 1984, but with ten additional levels, much enhanced graphics and other improvements.

459921.overview:
Boggle Bubble is a puzzle game released in 1992 by Silver Sword Software for the SAM Coupé. Players navigate through various rooms, collecting items and avoiding obstacles. The game features a distinct visual style with graphics by Jan Klima and music by Milan Salajka.

Each level presents unique challenges that require strategic thinking and quick reflexes. The game's design encourages players to solve puzzles efficiently while managing time constraints. Developed by Vojtech Klima, Boggle Bubble offers engaging gameplay within its retro setting.

460046.overview: Billy Blokk, the youngest in the line of the famous Blokk family returned from a nice bounce in the woods to find his home, Blokk Hall, strangely quiet. Strange blue shapes moving in the shadows confirmed his suspicions. The Oddballs, their ancient rivals had returned from the Underwurlde and kidnapped his family. He could only do one thing - save them! He would use his magic power of block levitation to crush his enemies finally. But very soon he learnt that a counter spell cast by the Oddballs meant the blocks were just as dangerous to him as to them.......
